description: Human/policy-reviewed expected labels enforcing strict impact-grounding rules

labels.rationalization: Connection pool capacity completely depleted (40/40 active, 0 idle, 17 waiting callers). Exhaustion of redundant pool capacity under active load.
Deadlock alone with transaction rollback does not establish persistent data corruption or cluster error rate. Without operational impact context, severity cannot be deterministically assigned.
Single ml-worker container terminated by OOMKiller. Localized single-instance task failure without cluster cascade.
Node DiskPressure evicting auxiliary pod log-collector. Localized secondary pod eviction preserving node health.
One HTTP 500 NullPointerException on /checkout path. A single request failure without traffic metrics or failure percentage cannot distinguish between an edge-case bug and a total outage.
Single report-generator worker recursion StackOverflowError on cyclic document graph. Localized document processing error.
Routine defensive perimeter rejection of expired JWT token (HTTP 401). Expected normal security behavior.
Targeted brute-force credential stuffing attack (48 failed attempts in 60s) resulting in admin account lockout. Confirmed security event.
Single CoreDNS UDP query timeout for pricing service. Without error rate or cluster blast radius, impact context is insufficient.
Single HTTP 502 connection refused from api-gateway to upstream. Single upstream failure without error rate or cluster metrics is insufficient.
Kafka consumer group backlog accumulating (135,788 messages) causing an explicit SLA breach with oldest message age 923s.
Poison-pill message delivery_tag=883920 requeued with redelivery_count=19. Localized single message deserialization failure.
